sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Dwijendra Mishra,Ram Naresh Yadav,Shalini Pandey Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.G.A. for the State and learned counsel for opposite party no.4.
2.

By means of this writ petition, the petitioners have sought quashing of the First Information Report dated 11.11.2022 registered as F.I.R./Case Crime No.0333 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323 and 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Jankipuram, District Lucknow.

sentences.text: 4. According to the terms of the compromise, parties have settled their dispute amicably.

They further agreed to withdraw the cases filed against each other including First Information Report dated11.11.2022 registered as F.I.R./Case Crime No.0333 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323 and 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Jankipuram, District Lucknow.

5. Learned counsel for the parties state that even the amount under the said agreement stands settled between the parties and that there are no further claims or demands against each other with respect to the matter involved in the present writ petition.
6 . C o n s i d e r i n g t h e t e r m s o f s e t t l e m e n t , w e , a c c o r d i n g l y , q u a s h t h e F I R .
A l l proceedings/investigation which may have been held consequent thereto are also quashed and the writ petition is allowed.

7. The Senior Registrar of this Court shall communicate this order to the Court concerned for correcting its record, accordingly.
8.
Learned AGA shall communicate this order to the investigating officer concerned.

[Vivek Chaudhary, J.] Order Date :- 6.12.2024 Piyush/-
